title: Find a test that fits you.
lead: Start with what has been on your mind. See what a test explores before deciding to begin.

groups.label: Work & energy
groups.description: Explore how work has been affecting your energy and sense of accomplishment.

groups.label: Worry & anxiety
groups.description: Choose a broader look at anxiety, or focus on how social situations feel.

groups.label: Workplace relationships
groups.description: Reflect on specific experiences of exclusion, pressure or bullying at work.

groups.label: Motivation
groups.prompt: I want to know what drives me
groups.description: Explore what matters to you in your work.

maslach-burnout-inventory.label: Work & energy
maslach-burnout-inventory.question: Feeling drained by work?
maslach-burnout-inventory.summary: Reflect on exhaustion, distance from work and your sense of accomplishment.
maslach-burnout-inventory.fit: You want to reflect on how work has been affecting you over the past few months.
maslach-burnout-inventory.outcome: A starting point for reflecting on your work experience and discussing it with someone you trust.
maslach-burnout-inventory.scope: Work and energy over the past few months.

spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.label: Worry & anxiety
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.question: Anxious now, or often?
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.summary: Explore how anxious you feel right now and how you generally feel.
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.fit: You want a broader look at anxiety, rather than a focus on social situations alone.
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.outcome: A way to reflect on the difference between your current feelings and your usual experience.
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.focus: I feel anxious now or often
spielberger-state-trait-anxiety-inventor.scope: Two parts: how you feel now and how you generally feel.

social-phobia-inventory-spin.label: Worry & anxiety
social-phobia-inventory-spin.question: Do social situations feel difficult?
social-phobia-inventory-spin.summary: Reflect on fear, avoidance and discomfort in social situations over the past week.
social-phobia-inventory-spin.fit: Your main concern is how being around other people or being observed has been feeling.
social-phobia-inventory-spin.outcome: A prompt to describe your recent social experiences more clearly.
social-phobia-inventory-spin.scope: Fear, avoidance and discomfort over the past week.

mobbing-test.label: Workplace relationships
mobbing-test.question: Feeling pushed out at work?
mobbing-test.summary: Reflect on experiences of bullying, exclusion or interference in your work.
mobbing-test.fit: You want to look more closely at specific things that have happened in your current workplace.
mobbing-test.outcome: A starting point for naming your experiences. It cannot establish whether bullying has occurred.
mobbing-test.focus: I feel excluded or mistreated at work
mobbing-test.scope: Specific experiences in your current workplace.

motivation-test-by-gerchikov.label: Motivation
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.question: What makes work meaningful to you?
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.summary: Explore the different things that motivate you in your working life.
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.fit: You are reflecting on what you value at work, rather than looking for a mental health assessment.
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.outcome: A prompt to think about your preferences and what you would like from your work.
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.focus: I want to understand what motivates me
motivation-test-by-gerchikov.scope: Your preferences and what you value at work.
